evidence.quote: The courses are conducted in English as well as in German.
Fulda University of Applied Sciences does not charge any tuition fees.

Applicants who have a foreign university entrance qualification (Attestat, Baccalauréat, Lise Diplomasi, International Baccalaureate, Swiadectwo ukonczenia etc.) and/or a foreign first degree apply via uni-assist - regardless of nationality and place of residence: www.uni-assist.de

notes: The DAAD page states 'Tuition fees per semester None' and the university's costs page confirms no tuition fees, but a semester contribution of around 400 EUR is charged; the latter is not tuition. Language rules: English B2 (IELTS 5.5, TOEFL iBT 72) is required; German C1 is an alternative condition, not required for all applicants. The application deadline 'until 15 July' lacks a year and is therefore not given as a date; a manual check is needed to confirm the exact deadline for the relevant year. Application channel: the pages state that applicants with a foreign university entrance qualification apply via uni-assist; there is no mention that documents must first be reviewed separately (VPD), so de-uni-assist is used.

evidence.quote: English language skills B2 required, please provide an official language certificate, e.g.: IELTS Academic: 5.5

note.fr: Vérifiez si votre certificat de fin d'études secondaires est reconnu comme qualification d'entrée à l'université en Allemagne ; une année préparatoire ou des examens supplémentaires peuvent être nécessaires.
note.en: Check whether your secondary school leaving certificate is recognised as a university entrance qualification in Germany; a preparatory year or additional exams may be required.

evidence.quote: A university entrance qualification ("Hochschulzugangsberechtigung", "HZB") for German universities
